decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Transport Statement, MDL-1258-PL-02 Rev. A, MDL-1258-PL-03, 1825/9, 1825/1 Rev. C, MDL-1258-PL-04, 1825/10 Received: 01 July 2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved materials as detailed on the document titled 'Proposed samples document outlining the materials to be used within the development' received 6th July 2015.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 1995 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/buildings within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out.
Condition : 5 - No plumbing or pipes, other than rainwater pipes, shall be fixed to the external faces of buildings or associated structures.

Condition : 6 - The approved landscaping scheme and maintenance plan shall be implemented and carried out as approved on drawing numbers 525-P-03 REV C, 10 Year Soft Landscape Maintenance and Management Plan received 2nd September 2015.The scheme shall be implemented and permanently thereafter.

Condition : 7 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am to 6:00pm Mondays to Friday, 8:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays, with no work to take place on Sundays and Bank Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - The full details outlining the scheme parking for the residential accommodation, garaging, manoeuvring, and the loading and unloading of vehicles shall be carried out as shown on drawing numbers 16-P1253-1 Rev. B and Transport Statement dated March 2015 received on 27th July 2016. The parking shall be laid out in accordance with the approved details prior to the occupation of the development hereby permitted and that area shall not thereafter be used for any other purpose, or obstructed in any way.
Condition : 9 - The development shall be operated in accordance with the approved Waste Management Strategy received: 25 January 2016 and permanently maintained thereafter.

Condition : 10 - All tree planting shall be carried out in accordance with those details approved on drawing numbers 525-P-04 REV A, 525-P-05 REV A received 2nd September 2015 and permanently maintained thereafter.

Condition : 11 - If within a period of (two years) from the date of the planting of any tree, that tree, or any tree planted in replacement for it, is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, (or becomes, in the opinion of the local planning authority, seriously damaged or defective,) another tree of the same species and size as that originally planted shall be planted at the same place, unless the local planning authority gives its written consent to any variation
Condition : 12 - No fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the site.

Condition : 13 - The desk study report and scheme for decontamination shall be carried out as approved in documents titled 'desk study and ground investigation document, Ground Investigation works by Ridge' received on 6th July 2015. 

   During the course of the development:
c.	The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues.  
   Before the development is first brought into use:
d.      The agreed scheme for decontamination referred to in clauses b) and c) above, including amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.

Condition : 14 - The proposed cycle parking storage shall be implemented as approved (on drawing number proposed details of cycle storage received 6th July 2015) and maintained permanently thereafter.

Condition : 15 - The approved Sustainable Drainage Scheme shall be implemented as approved on the drawing numbers 5946/01 REV A, 5946/02 REV A, Soakaway Design to BRE 365, Sustainable Drainage Management Plan and Maintenance Plan received on the 2nd September 2015. These details shall be carried out as approved and maintained permanently thereafter.

Condition : 16 - The development hereby permitted shall be designed and constructed in accordance with the Lifetimes Home Standards as set out in the London Plan and Accessible London Supplementary Planning Guidance.

Condition : 17 - (A) The internal water consumption of the development will not exceed 105 l/p/day in line with The Water Efficiency Calculator for new dwellings from the Department of Communities and Local Government as approved (drawing number details of water efficiency received: 6th July 2015).

(B) The building(s) shall not be occupied until evidence (schedule of fittings and manufactures literature) has  be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved internal water use calculations.

Condition : 18 - (A) The approved Sustainable Urban Drainage Scheme shall be implemented as approved on drawing numbers 5946/01 REV A, 5946/02 REV A, Soakaway Design to BRE 365, Sustainable Drainage Management Plan and Maintenance Plan received 2nd September 2015. 
(B) The building(s) shall not be occupied until evidence has (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) have been submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to demonstrate that the development has been carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 19 - (A) The approved recyclable and non-recyclable stores shall be implemented as approved (on drawing numbers 1825/1 REV C, 1825/11 REV A, 1825/8, 1825/6 REV A received: 6th July 2015). The stores shall be permanently maintained thereafter.

(B) The building(s) shall not be occupied until evidence has (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) have been submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to demonstrate that the development has been carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 20 - (A)	(A) The sustainable elements of the development shall be implemented as approved (in drawing numbers Sustainability Material use and Selection document, Roof Plan Layout for solar panels received 6th July 2015) and maintained permanently thereafter. 

(B) The building(s) shall not be occupied until evidence has (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) have been submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to demonstrate that the development has been carried out in accordance with the approved details.
Condition : 21 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Construction Management Plan received 6th July 2015.

Condition : 22 - The approved scheme for protecting the proposed residential accommodation from excessive external noise shall be implemented and any works which form part of such a scheme shall be completed before any part of the development is first occupied or used.

Condition : 23 - The approved shared surface shall be carried out as approved on drawing number 1825/11 REV A received on the 6th July 2015. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.

Condition : 24 - The cover letter submitted dated 26 June 2016 confirms that no resident of the development (including number 70 Thorney Hedge Road) shall obtain a resident's parking permit within any controlled parking zone which may be in force in the area at any time.

Condition : 25 - The bin store shown on the approved drawings shall be provided prior to the occupation of the development and shall be permanently retained thereafter unless otherwise agreed beforehand by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Variation of condition 3 to reduce the amount of alterations to the existing house No.70 Thorney Hedge Road to accommodate the new 3.5m wide access road following planning permission 01121/C/P1 dated 10/06/2015 for demolition of garages and erection of 6 two storey houses and associated landscaping, alterations and partial demolition of 70 Thorney Hedge Road.
